svg.title: MOIST — accelerating portal drop
svg.desc: The drop falls into the orange bottom portal and emerges from the blue top portal. Ten portal passages preserve downward momentum under constant acceleration, with speed increasing linearly in time. Slimming responds to speed squared, remaining subtle at first and growing stronger near full speed. After the tenth passage it catches abruptly in the original wordmark, squashes, and jiggles back into shape. 11-second loop with pauses at the initial position. Reduced motion displays the initial logo and portals. Transparent background; no scripts or external assets.
